title: Hold a tattoo licence
what: Hold an operator licence before carrying on a body art tattooing business at premises; tattooists need their own licence (s 7).

sources.title: Tattoo Industry Act 2013 (Qld)
sources.quote: A person must not carry on a body art tattooing business, whether on the person’s own behalf or on behalf of another person, at premises unless the person is authorised to do so by an operator licence.
